item.title: Europeans Are About to Find Out How Entrenched AI Is in Their Daily Lives
item.description: New EU rules stipulate that people must be told when they’re interacting with AI or looking at AI-generated or -edited content, leading to fear of “disclosure fatigue.”

item.title: 200 000 appareils piratés : ce botnet utilise la blockchain pour brouiller les pistes
item.description: Un botnet intitulé Dysphoria est parvenu à compromettre 200 000 objets connectés dans le monde. En pleine expansion, le botnet s'appuie sur la blockchain pour dissimuler ses serveurs de commande et échapper aux outils de surveillance.

item.title: I’ve driven the new Cupra Raval and it’s proof that the hot hatch can live on in the EV era
item.description: Cupra unleashes the first car on the new Volkswagen MEB+ platform and it's a proper pocket rocket

item.title: RTX 5090, 96 Go de RAM et écran Mini LED 4K : ce PC portable gaming ultime s’allège de 800 €
item.description: L'Acer Predator Helios 18 AI propose une fiche technique ultra-musclée : écran Mini LED 4K de 18 pouces, processeur Intel Core Ultra 9, GeForce RTX 5090 et 96 Go de RAM DDR5. Cette configuration extrême est proposée à 5 199 euros au lieu de 5 999 euros directement sur le site Acer.

item.title: The after-hours advantage: Why your life outside of work matters
item.description: The creativity and perspective that distinguish workers from AI are often developed away from the office. Americans, however, are spending less time building those skills. In a world where AI is taking on an increasing share of repetitive tasks, there’s a higher premium on the unique perspective, identities, and experiences that knowledge workers bring to their jobs from outside of work. However, Americans are participating less in the activities that enrich these attributes....

item.title: Your high performer is checked out. Now what?
item.description: Three potential reasons for disengagement at work and what you can do about them. One of the most difficult things to do as a manager is to deal with an employee who just isn’t feeling it and remains unmotivated for a long period of time. Everyone has their days when they’d rather be anywhere else but at work, but what do you do when a direct report consistently fails to bring energy and enthusiasm to their work?...
